title: Build Advisor — deck advisor (RU/EN)
description:
[h1]Build Advisor[/h1]
An in-game deck-building advisor for Slay the Spire 2. It rates every card, relic and shop item against [b]your current deck[/b] and shows why.

[h2]What it does[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Card rewards[/b] — a ribbon under every card: tier S–D, score 0–100 and the expected change of the win rate against skipping; the Skip button gets its own ribbon. Hover for the full breakdown.
[*][b]Shop[/b] — ribbons on cards, relics and the card removal service, and a purchase plan that fits your gold.
[*][b]Campfire and events[/b] — rest or upgrade plus the options relics add (Shovel, Girya, Meat Cleaver, Pael's Growth, Pumpkin Candle, Byrdonis Egg, Miniature Tent, rest rewards); upgrade, removal, transform and enchant priorities on the deck grid; community win-rate verdicts on event options, including Ancients.
[*][b]Relic choices, potions, map route[/b] — relic ratings, potion advice on the rewards screen, expected damage and HP after each map node with the recommended path.
[*][b]Archetypes[/b] — community winning decks (Spire Codex Pick Coach) or your own manual choice.
[*][b]Co-op[/b] — reads your teammates' decks: protect a fragile teammate, empower an attacker, avoid copying their engine.
[*][b]Run review[/b] at the end of a run.
[/list]

[h2]Where the numbers come from[/h2]
Community statistics from [url=https://spire-codex.com/]Spire Codex[/url] plus deck adjustments. The adjustment weights are calibrated on 177,251 runs (1.6 million card rewards) and checked on held-out runs.

[h2]Controls[/h2]
The red wax seal [b]BD[/b] at the left edge of the screen or [b]F8[/b] opens the panel. Russian / English, offline mode, optional auto-pick (off by default) that does what the panel advises: takes or skips card rewards and buys the shop plan.

Unless you turn on auto-pick, the mod never acts for you; it does not change the game's rules. Advice is statistics, not a guarantee.

[h2]Русский[/h2]
Советник по сборке колоды: оценивает награды, магазин, реликвии, костёр, события и маршрут с учётом вашей колоды. Метки S–D, оценка 0–100 и п.п. к победе против пропуска; полный разбор при наведении. Панель — печать BD у левого края или F8. Веса поправок откалиброваны на 177 тыс. забегов.

Source code and issues: [url=https://github.com/Tkachov0Vitalii/Build_advisor]GitHub[/url] · Nexus Mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/slaythespire2/mods/1588]Build Advisor[/url]
changeNote: 7.1.0: auto-pick follows the panel (takes or skips card rewards, buys the shop plan); ribbons on the Skip button and the shop's card removal; campfire advice includes relic options (Shovel, Girya, Meat Cleaver, Pael's Growth, Pumpkin Candle, Byrdonis Egg, Miniature Tent, rest rewards); panel text no longer runs past the edge.
